title: Your LLM Judge Is Hallucinating Too — Brian Kennedy, ZoomInfo
summary: ZoomInfo's agent reported that it scheduled an email. It never did, and the LLM judge checking its work approved it anyway. title: Stop Paying LLM Prices for Yes-or-No Answers — Chinmay Goyal, Glean
summary: Most steps in an AI product are bounded decisions, not generation: classifying a query, routing to an expert, ranking suggestions, checking a citation. Chinmay Goyal, a software engineer on Glean Assistant, shows how Glean moved these steps to Jev, TypeSafe's decision model.
